answer: Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the mesa queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 547 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the mirror. The ridge index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 236 account operation therefore ties up 24 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
